product.description: Monoprice™75" Cable Trench System with One Exit PointModular In‑Wall Cable Management for Professional AV and Network InstallationsThe 75‑Inch Cable Trench System is a fully modular in‑wall cable concealment solution designed to deliver a clean, professional finish for AV rack rooms, control centers, and head‑end installations. Engineered for flexibility and scalability, this innovative system offers complete customization to meet your specific project requirements‑whether you need a 15‑inch vertical run or a full 75‑inch cable trench.The Cable Trench System includes (5) 15‑inch back boxes, (1) pass‑through end cap, (1) end cap with conduit and electrical knockout, (4) solid screw covers, and (1) brush cover‑providing a complete 75‑inch system ready for installation. Each section connects seamlessly, allowing you to extend or shorten the total height as needed. With this modular design, you can tailor configurations to accommodate various service loop exit points or equipment rack heights‑ideal for installations requiring precision and adaptability.Perfect for rack rooms, audio head‑end spaces, and structured wiring environments, the Cable Trench System keeps cables organized, protected, and completely concealed within the wall. The solid screw covers create a sleek, flush finish, while the brush cover offers a tidy exit point for cables‑maintaining accessibility without compromising aesthetics. The end cap with integrated conduit and electrical knockouts simplifies power and data routing, supporting a wide range of professional AV and IT applications.Each component in the system is constructed from high‑quality, durable materials engineered for long‑term performance and reliability. The modular back boxes are designed for easy alignment and installation, streamlining on‑site setup. For added flexibility, all individual parts are also available separately in convenient 5‑packs, enabling installers to design fully customized configurations beyond the standard 75‑inch layout.Whether you're running HDMI®, Cat6, fiber, or power cabling, the Cable Trench System delivers a professional‑grade solution that simplifies maintenance, improves organization, and enhances the overall appearance of your installation.
